questions.prompt: The Aztec capital stood on an island in which feature?
questions.fact: Causeways and canals linked it to the shore, and the Spanish later drained the basin to build over it.

questions.prompt: Which blood cells are chiefly responsible for carrying oxygen?
questions.fact: They lose their nucleus as they mature in humans, which leaves more room for haemoglobin.

questions.prompt: In which sport is the Thomas Cup contested?
questions.fact: It is the men's world team championship, held every two years since 1949 and long dominated by Indonesia and China.

questions.prompt: Which jazz trumpeter recorded the album Kind of Blue?
questions.fact: Much of it was recorded in first takes from sketched scales rather than written-out chord changes.

questions.prompt: Which European capital is split by the Danube into two historic halves?
questions.fact: The hilly western side and the flat eastern side were separate towns until they merged in 1873.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'The Old Man and the Sea'?
questions.fact: It was the last major work published in his lifetime and was cited when he won the Nobel Prize two years later.

questions.prompt: Which company developed the Windows operating system?
questions.fact: Its first version in 1985 was a graphical shell running on top of an existing disk operating system.
